  CITY OF MONTEREY PARK CITY COUNCIL
  INTRODUCTION OF GUESTS AND PRESENTATIONS
  TUESDAY
  February 19, 2019
  6:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  320 WEST NEWMARK AVENUE
  Monterey Park, CA 91754

  CONGRATULATIONS!

  On the celebration of your 97th birthday, the City Council extends our sincere
  congratulations on this special occasion.

  Alicia Ochoa

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)

  IN RECOGNITION!
  Of Optimist Day, the first Thursday of every February, recognizes volunteers working
  with young people to make a positive difference in the community, the City Council
  applauds your hard work and dedication.

  LAMP Optimist Club
  Eastside Optimist Club
  Bella Vista Optimist Club

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)

  CONGRATULATIONS!

  To the 2019 Miss Los Angeles Chinatown Queen and her Court, the City Council
  applauds your service as ambassadors for the LA Chinatown community.

  Kellie Chin – Queen & Miss Photogenic
  Isabell Liu – 1st Princess
  Sela Wang – 2nd Princess
  Ashley Thompson – 3rd Princess
  Barbara Wong – Miss Friendship

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)
   IN RECOGNITION!
Of your appointment as the new Executive Director for MERCI, the City Council extends
  our welcome and best wishes for success.

  Jillian Van Leuven

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)

  CONGRATULATIONS!

For a successful performance in the FIRST (For Inspiration and Recognition of Science
and Technology) Lego League “Into Orbit” Walnut Qualifier Tournament, advancing to
  the L.A. Regional Championship Tournament and proudly representing Monterey
  Highlands Elementary School, the City Council congratulates you.

  BRAINY BOTS
  (Named Champions at the tournament for being best all around, they also won the Judge’s
  Award at an earlier tournament, Blockhead Bash Rewind)
  Gavin Chan
  Kiera Chan
  Sonia Hinojosa
  Nicholas Jung
  Cesar Osorio
  Kristine Sy
  Justin Wong

  DREAM TEAM
  (Won 1st place in the Core Values category, recognizing their inclusion and teamwork)
  Ethan Amaro
  Raelene Aragon
  Sarah Duong
  Sophia Duong
  Andrew Duran
  Diego Ruiz
  Alex Song
  Gabrielle Wong

  (Presented by Council Member Ing)

  IN RECOGNITION!
 For your outstanding citizenship as well as being a valuable community member, the
  City Council recognizes your contributions toward enhancing the quality of life in
  Monterey Park.

  Fumiko “Mickey” Maruya

  (Presented by Council Member Real Sebastian)
   IN RECOGNITION!
For being the first female football player, ever for the East Los Angeles College
  Huskies, the City Council recognizes your outstanding accomplishments.

  Toni Harris

  (Presented by Council Member Real Sebastian)
